# Test fixtures

- `disscube-grids/<case>__<file>.toml`: the pipeline files of `LambdaGeo/disscube-grids` at commit `77e6659`
  (release v1.1.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23502247), copied unchanged. They ran with DisSCube 0.6.0.
- `olw_derivations.template.toml`: `pipeline/grid/derivations.template.toml` of `LambdaGeo/open-lucc-workflow`
  at commit `04f0ec2`, copied unchanged. Its `[grid]` is rendered by `scripts/render_pipeline.py` of that repository.
